findings.location: Example, sentence beginning “This vector may be used as the conserved field U”
findings.evidence: The Example defines M as a vector at one fixed point, then says that vector may be used as the field U. The cited definition requires U to be a locally integrable map on a space-time domain. A point value does not have that field type; the sentence should refer to a field with this pointwise value and separately require local integrability.
